question: How much tax does Alice have to pay in 2017?
text: Alice and Bob got married on Aug 6th, 2010. Their son Charlie was born February 2nd, 2012. Alice and Bob were legally separated under a decree of divorce on March 2nd, 2015. In 2017, Alice and Charlie live at a house maintained by Alice. Alice's gross income for the year 2017 is $9560. Alice takes the standard deduction.
